title: How We Met
synopsis: The day two worlds collided and everything changed.
story:
It was one of those days that started out ordinary. I was going about my usual routine, not expecting anything different.

But then you walked in. We talked like we had known each other forever — no awkwardness, no hesitation.

That day changed everything. I just didn't know it yet.

title: Our First Official Date
synopsis: Nervous outfits, nervous hearts, and a night to remember.
story:
I changed my outfit three times before you picked me up. But the moment I saw your smile, all the nerves melted away.

Dinner was wonderful, but the walk afterwards was even better. We talked for hours.

That night, I knew this was something special.

title: Our First Real Laugh
synopsis: The moment I knew I wanted to laugh with you forever.
story:
Do you remember that ridiculous thing that happened? We couldn't stop laughing — the kind where your stomach hurts.

I knew right then that I wanted to laugh with you every single day.

You have the most beautiful laugh I've ever heard.

title: Our First Fight
synopsis: We fought. We came back stronger.
story:
It was messy and hurtful and I hated every second of it.

You knocked on my door with that look in your eyes — the one that said 'I'm sorry' without words.

That fight taught me we could weather anything together.

title: First Valentine's Day
synopsis: Flowers, dinner, and a note I found later.
story:
You surprised me. You always know how to surprise me.

The flowers, the dinner, that little note you tucked into my pocket that I didn't find until later.

But the best gift was just being with you.

title: Our First Trip Together
synopsis: Five days of adventure, coffee, and rainy hotel rooms.
story:
Packing together, getting lost, finding that tiny café with the best coffee.

Even the rainy day we spent curled up in the hotel room was perfect.

I learned more about you in those five days than I had in months.

title: The Day We Moved In Together
synopsis: Cardboard boxes, pizza on the floor, and home.
story:
Cardboard boxes everywhere, arguing about where the couch should go.

It was chaos. Beautiful, wonderful chaos.

Waking up the next morning in our home — that was the moment it all felt real.

title: The Day You Took Care of Me
synopsis: Soup from scratch and unconditional love.
story:
I was sick and miserable. But you were there. Every single moment.

You made soup from scratch because 'canned soup isn't going to cut it.'

That's when I knew. This isn't just love. This is partnership.

title: One Year Down
synopsis: 365 days of learning, growing, and loving.
story:
One year. We made it look easy.

We celebrated with a quiet dinner and a walk under the stars.

Here's to many more years of this beautiful adventure.

title: That Time We Got Lost
synopsis: Wrong turns make the best stories.
story:
We were trying to find that new restaurant. Instead, we ended up in the middle of nowhere.

But we found a random food truck that served the best tacos we've ever had.

Getting lost with you is better than arriving anywhere without you.

title: A Random Tuesday I Loved
synopsis: Nothing special happened. That's what made it perfect.
story:
We grocery shopped together, made dinner, watched that show we're obsessed with.

Sometimes the most beautiful moments are the ones where nothing extraordinary happens.

Because being with you makes everything extraordinary.

title: Two Years and Still Falling
synopsis: 730 days. A silent promise on a mountaintop.
story:
We celebrated with a trip — our favorite thing to do.

Standing on that overlook, watching the sunset, I made a silent promise.

I promised to keep choosing you, every single day, for the rest of my life.

title: Our First Christmas Together
synopsis: Matching pajamas and a tree full of memories.
story:
We decorated the tree together, burned the cookies, and danced in the kitchen.

You gave me a photo album of our year together. I cried.

This is what Christmas was always supposed to feel like.

title: The Great Adventure
story:
We woke up on a Saturday and decided to just drive.

No plan, no map, just each other and the open road.

We ended up at a beach we'd never heard of, watching the most beautiful sunset.

title: The Cooking Disaster
synopsis: We set off the smoke alarm. Worth it.
story:
We decided to cook an elaborate dinner from scratch.

Thirty minutes in, the smoke alarm was going off, flour was everywhere, and we were laughing so hard we couldn't breathe.

We ordered pizza and ate it on the floor. Perfect.

title: The Quiet Before the Storm
synopsis: A coffee shop, two books, and comfortable silence.
story:
We sat in that coffee shop for three hours, barely speaking.

Just reading our books, sipping coffee, and being perfectly content in each other's presence.

That's when I knew we'd made it. When silence feels like home.

title: Three Years
synopsis: 1096 days of the most beautiful story.
story:
Three years. One thousand and ninety-six days of loving you.

Every morning I wake up next to you, every night I fall asleep in your arms — it all adds up to the most beautiful story.

I love you more today than yesterday. And I'll love you more tomorrow than today.

Happy anniversary, my love.
